'''Zora Sasori''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[warrior]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
[[File:FDGMK_FC_character_art.png|thumb|left|180px|Sasori wielding her lightsaber]]
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she teamed with [[Unidentified Jedi group|other Force-sensitives]] searching for a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] at the [[Well of Shadows]]. They were pursued by [[Sor Venge]], an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] who was also seeking the holocron. When the group arrived at the Well of Shadows, they discovered [[Kasuni Tamm]], a latent Force-sensitive [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] explorer already there with the holocron. The group came under attack by Venge and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] but Sasori was able to escape with Tamm and the others.

==Personality and traits==
Sasori wielded a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that emitted a [[Color/Legends|blue]] blade.

==Behind the scenes==
Zora appears in the introductory story and gameplay example for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] book [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]].
